name: Telugu Desam Party
description: The Telugu Desam Party (TDP) is a regional political party based primarily in Andhra Pradesh. Founded in 1982 by Telugu film actor and politician N. T. Rama Rao (NTR), the party was established to promote Telugu self-respect, regional development, good governance and welfare-oriented policies. TDP has played a major role in Andhra Pradesh politics and has formed governments multiple times. The party is currently led by N. Chandrababu Naidu.
achievements: Founded in 1982 and quickly became a major political force in Andhra Pradesh.
N. T. Rama Rao introduced several welfare schemes including subsidised rice programmes.
Chandrababu Naidu promoted information technology and attracted investment to Hyderabad during his tenure.
Developed Hyderabad as a major IT and technology hub during the united Andhra Pradesh period.
Focused on infrastructure development and urban planning.
Promoted Amaravati as the planned capital city of Andhra Pradesh.
Implemented women self-help group programmes and rural development initiatives.
Returned to power in Andhra Pradesh in 2024 as part of NDA alliance.
criticisms: Opposition parties have criticised TDP over land acquisition policies related to Amaravati.
Critics have questioned the party's focus on urban development compared to rural welfare.
The party has faced criticism regarding alliance changes over the years.
Opponents have accused the party of favouring corporate investment.
Political rivals have raised concerns over governance decisions during previous governments.
protests: Campaigns supporting Andhra Pradesh special category status.
Movements related to Amaravati capital development.
Protests on farmer issues and agricultural concerns.
Campaigns demanding greater financial support for Andhra Pradesh after bifurcation.
Public movements on unemployment and economic development.
timeline: 1982 - Telugu Desam Party founded by N. T. Rama Rao.
1983 - TDP won Andhra Pradesh Assembly election and formed government within one year of formation.
1984 - NTR government was briefly dismissed and later restored after political protests.
1985 - NTR returned as Chief Minister after winning elections.
1995 - N. Chandrababu Naidu became Chief Minister after internal party changes.
1999 - TDP formed alliance with BJP-led NDA and performed strongly in elections.
2004 - TDP lost Andhra Pradesh Assembly election.
2014 - After Andhra Pradesh bifurcation, TDP formed the first elected government of Andhra Pradesh under Chandrababu Naidu.
2019 - TDP lost Andhra Pradesh Assembly election.
2024 - TDP returned to power in Andhra Pradesh and joined NDA alliance.
